<button onclick="window.print()" style="float:right;margin-bottom:1rem">🖨 Print / Save as PDF</button>

::: {.callout-note}
## Overview
SeaPrep isolates nuclei from small, soft tissue (e.g. ganglia) for single-nucleus work. Tissue is homogenized in a citrate-based homogenization buffer (CitraHB) with a handheld homogenizer, then nuclei are pelleted and washed at low speed — **no iodixanol gradient and no ultracentrifuge**. RNase inhibitors go into the CitraHB Complete and the resuspension buffer. Spermine, spermidine, and dithiothreitol (DTT) are left **out** of the resuspension buffer because they interfere with downstream cDNA synthesis.

For firm or snap-frozen tissue that needs density-gradient purification, use the **CitraPrep** protocol instead.

<!-- TODO: confirm source/citation for this protocol with JP -->
:::

::: {.callout-important}
## Before starting
- Use **cell culture grade water** for every "water" call in this protocol.
- Make 1 M Tricine–Potassium Hydroxide (Tricine-KOH, pH 7.8) and 1 M Citric Acid stocks first; CitraHB and the resuspension buffer are built from them.
- Prepare CitraHB and Detergent stock buffers **a day ahead**; good for 1 month at 4°C.
- Make 1 M Dithiothreitol (DTT), 0.15 M spermine, and 0.5 M spermidine (1000X stocks) **fresh** each time.
- Make CitraHB Complete (stock + protease inhibitor tablet) fresh; add spermine/spermidine/DTT to bring it to 1X.
- Make the resuspension buffer with **no** spermine, spermidine, or DTT in it.
- A handheld/electric homogenizer is fine here — the tissue is soft.
:::

---

## Configure experiment

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof n_samples  = Inputs.number({label: "Number of samples", value: 1, min: 1, max: 24, step: 1})
viewof excess_pct = Inputs.number({label: "Extra overage on scaled solutions (%)", value: 0, min: 0, max: 30, step: 5})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Per-sample working volumes. CitraHB Complete is made in 10 mL increments
// (whole protease inhibitor tablets), so its total is always rounded UP to the
// next 10 mL — set the per-sample number here and the table below does the rest.
viewof chb_per_sample = Inputs.number({label: "CitraHB Complete per sample (mL) — homogenization volume", value: 3, min: 1, step: 1})
viewof wash_per_spin  = Inputs.number({label: "Resuspension volume per wash spin (mL)", value: 10, min: 1, step: 1})
viewof n_wash_spins   = Inputs.number({label: "Number of wash spins", value: 1, min: 0, max: 5, step: 1})
viewof final_resus_uL = Inputs.number({label: "Final resuspension volume (µL)", value: 200, min: 50, step: 50})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// RNase inhibitor final AND stock concentrations, per inhibitor. SUPERase•In
// (superasin) is commonly sold at 20 U/µL and RNasin / Protector at 40 U/µL —
// check your tubes. Set a final conc to 0 to leave that inhibitor out.
viewof superase_final = Inputs.number({label: "SUPERasin final conc. (U/µL)", value: 0.5, min: 0, step: 0.05})
viewof superase_stock = Inputs.number({label: "SUPERasin stock conc. (U/µL)", value: 40, min: 1, step: 1})
viewof rnasin_final   = Inputs.number({label: "Protector / RNasin final conc. (U/µL)", value: 0.5, min: 0, step: 0.05})
viewof rnasin_stock   = Inputs.number({label: "Protector / RNasin stock conc. (U/µL)", value: 40, min: 1, step: 1})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
scale = n_samples * (1 + excess_pct / 100)
fmt   = (x, d = 2) => x.toFixed(d)

MW    = ({sucrose: 342.30, KCl: 74.55, MgCl2: 203.30, glycine: 75.07, sorbitol: 182.17, tricine: 179.17, citric: 192.124})
solid = (M, V, mw) => M * (V / 1000) * mw   // grams of a solid at molarity M in V mL

// Stock volume needed to hit a final conc in total volume V (V and result share units).
superase_vol = (V) => superase_final * V / superase_stock
rnasin_vol   = (V) => rnasin_final   * V / rnasin_stock

md`**${n_samples} sample(s) · ${excess_pct}% overage · SUPERasin ${superase_final} U/µL (stock ${superase_stock}) · Protector ${rnasin_final} U/µL (stock ${rnasin_stock})**`
```

## Stock buffers

Make ~1 month's supply at once; store at 4°C. These do **not** scale with sample count.

### 1 M stock reagents (make first)

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof stock_vol_mL = Inputs.number({label: "1M stock batch volume (mL)", value: 100, min: 10, step: 10})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Inputs.table([
  {Component: "Tricine (free acid)", "Amount": `${fmt(solid(1, stock_vol_mL, MW.tricine))} g`, "Recipe": `Dissolve in ~80% of ${fmt(stock_vol_mL, 0)} mL water; titrate to pH 7.8 with Potassium Hydroxide (KOH); bring to ${fmt(stock_vol_mL, 0)} mL`},
  {Component: "Citric Acid",         "Amount": `${fmt(solid(1, stock_vol_mL, MW.citric))} g`,  "Recipe": `Dissolve in water to ${fmt(stock_vol_mL, 0)} mL`}
], {layout: "auto"})
```

### CitraHB

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof citrahb_vol = Inputs.number({label: "CitraHB batch volume (mL)", value: 20, min: 5, step: 5})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Inputs.table([
  {Component: "Sucrose",            "Final": "0.25 M", "Amount": `${fmt(solid(0.25, citrahb_vol, MW.sucrose))} g`},
  {Component: "Potassium Chloride (KCl)",   "Final": "225 mM", "Amount": `${fmt(solid(0.225, citrahb_vol, MW.KCl))} g`},
  {Component: "Magnesium Chloride (MgCl₂·6H₂O)", "Final": "5 mM", "Amount": `${fmt(solid(0.005, citrahb_vol, MW.MgCl2), 4)} g`},
  {Component: "Tricine-KOH pH 7.8", "Final": "20 mM",  "Amount": `${fmt(20 * citrahb_vol, 0)} µL of 1 M stock`},
  {Component: "Citric Acid",        "Final": "10 mM",  "Amount": `${fmt(10 * citrahb_vol, 0)} µL of 1 M stock`},
  {Component: "Glycine",            "Final": "50 mM",  "Amount": `${fmt(solid(0.05, citrahb_vol, MW.glycine), 4)} g`},
  {Component: "Sorbitol",           "Final": "50 mM",  "Amount": `${fmt(solid(0.05, citrahb_vol, MW.sorbitol), 4)} g`}
], {layout: "auto"})
```

Dissolve in cell culture grade water to the batch volume.

### Detergent (1 mL)

| Component | Amount |
|-----------|--------|
| IGEPAL CA-630 | 50 µL |
| CitraHB | 950 µL |

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Diluent — optional, not used in the steps below
Included from the buffer set for gradient work; the SeaPrep steps below don't use it. Recipe for **5 mL** (scale linearly): KCl 375 mM (0.1397 g), MgCl₂·6H₂O 30 mM (0.0304 g), Tricine-KOH pH 7.8 120 mM (600 µL of 1 M stock), Citric Acid 10 mM (50 µL of 1 M stock), Glycine 50 mM (0.0189 g), Sorbitol 50 mM (0.0455 g). Dissolve to 5 mL.
:::

---

## Fresh working solutions (1000X stocks)

Make fresh each time; do not store. Scale to the volume you need.

| Component | Final stock | Recipe |
|-----------|-------------|--------|
| 1 M Dithiothreitol (DTT) | 1000X | 0.077 g in 500 µL cell culture grade water |
| 0.15 M spermine | 1000X | 0.015 g in 500 µL cell culture grade water |
| 0.5 M spermidine | 1000X | 0.0363 g in 500 µL cell culture grade water |

Add spermine, spermidine, and Dithiothreitol (DTT) to CitraHB Complete for a final 1X concentration. Add SUPERasin and Protector to **both** CitraHB Complete and the resuspension buffer at the final concentrations set in **Configure experiment** (default 0.5 U/µL each). Do **not** add spermine, spermidine, or DTT to the resuspension buffer.

---

## Working solutions: scaled to sample count

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Math audit: how every volume is calculated

**CitraHB Complete** — made in 10 mL increments because each aliquot takes one whole protease inhibitor tablet, so the total is rounded **up** to the next 10 mL:

$$V_{make} = \left\lceil \frac{v_{per\ sample} \times N_{samples} \times (1 + overage)}{10} \right\rceil \times 10 \qquad tablets = \frac{V_{make}}{10}$$

**Resuspension buffer** — one pool covers the wash spin(s) and the final resuspension:

$$V_{buffer} = \left( v_{wash} \times n_{spins} + \frac{V_{final\ \mu L}}{1000} \right) \times N_{samples} \times (1 + overage)$$

BSA is 1% w/v of $V_{buffer}$; SUPERasin and Protector use $V_{stock} = (C_{final}/C_{stock}) \times V_{buffer}$, each with its own stock strength.
:::

### CitraHB Complete

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
chb_need     = chb_per_sample * scale
chb_vol      = Math.ceil(chb_need / 10) * 10
chb_tablets  = chb_vol / 10
detergent_uL = 50 * chb_per_sample   // 50 µL Detergent per mL CitraHB Complete used to homogenize

md`**Need ≈ ${fmt(chb_need)} mL for ${n_samples} sample(s) → make ${fmt(chb_vol, 0)} mL** (rounded up to a 10 mL multiple: **${chb_tablets} mini protease tablet(s)**). Detergent for homogenization: **${fmt(detergent_uL, 0)} µL/sample**.`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Inputs.table([
  {Component: "Mini protease inhibitor tablet",           "Per 10 mL": "1 whole tablet",                 "Total": `${chb_tablets} tablet(s)`},
  {Component: `SUPERasin (${superase_final} U/µL final)`,  "Per 10 mL": `${fmt(superase_vol(10000))} µL`,  "Total (µL)": fmt(superase_vol(chb_vol * 1000))},
  {Component: `Protector (${rnasin_final} U/µL final)`,    "Per 10 mL": `${fmt(rnasin_vol(10000))} µL`,    "Total (µL)": fmt(rnasin_vol(chb_vol * 1000))},
  {Component: "Spermidine (1000X)",                       "Per 10 mL": "10 µL",                           "Total (µL)": fmt(chb_vol)},
  {Component: "Spermine (1000X)",                         "Per 10 mL": "10 µL",                           "Total (µL)": fmt(chb_vol)},
  {Component: "Dithiothreitol (DTT, 1000X)",              "Per 10 mL": "10 µL",                           "Total (µL)": fmt(chb_vol)},
  {Component: "CitraHB stock",                            "Per 10 mL": "to volume",                       "Total (mL)": fmt(chb_vol)}
], {layout: "auto"})
```

### Resuspension buffer

::: {.callout-warning}
## No spermine, spermidine, or DTT in this buffer
These interfere with downstream cDNA synthesis.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
resus_per_sample = wash_per_spin * n_wash_spins + final_resus_uL / 1000
resus_vol = resus_per_sample * scale

md`**${fmt(resus_per_sample)} mL/sample × ${n_samples} → ${fmt(resus_vol)} mL** (${n_wash_spins} wash spin(s) of ${fmt(wash_per_spin)} mL + ${fmt(final_resus_uL)} µL final resuspension)`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Inputs.table([
  {Component: "Bovine Serum Albumin (BSA)",       "Final": "1% w/v",  "Amount": `${fmt(0.01 * resus_vol)} g`},
  {Component: "Potassium Chloride (KCl)",         "Final": "250 mM",  "Amount": `${fmt(solid(0.25, resus_vol, MW.KCl))} g`},
  {Component: "Magnesium Chloride (MgCl₂·6H₂O)",  "Final": "≈ 2.5 mM", "Amount": `${fmt(0.0095 * resus_vol / 20, 4)} g`},
  {Component: "Tricine-KOH pH 7.8",               "Final": "20 mM",   "Amount": `${fmt(20 * resus_vol, 0)} µL of 1 M stock`},
  {Component: "Glycine",                          "Final": "50 mM",   "Amount": `${fmt(solid(0.05, resus_vol, MW.glycine), 4)} g`},
  {Component: "Sorbitol",                         "Final": "50 mM",   "Amount": `${fmt(solid(0.05, resus_vol, MW.sorbitol), 4)} g`},
  {Component: `SUPERasin (${superase_final} U/µL final)`, "Final": "—", "Amount": `${fmt(superase_vol(resus_vol))} mL`},
  {Component: `Protector (${rnasin_final} U/µL final)`,   "Final": "—", "Amount": `${fmt(rnasin_vol(resus_vol))} mL`}
], {layout: "auto"})
```

::: {.callout-note}
The MgCl₂ mass follows the source recipe as written (0.0095 g / 20 mL ≈ 2.5 mM MgCl₂·6H₂O). The recipe nominally lists 5 mM — confirm which is intended before scaling up.
:::

Dissolve BSA and salts in cell culture grade water to volume, then add SUPERasin and Protector.

## Protocol

### 1 · Homogenization & counting

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
homog_rows = [
  {Action: `Homogenize the tissue (e.g. ganglia) in CitraHB Complete + Detergent in a round-bottom tube with a handheld homogenizer.`, "Per sample": `${fmt(chb_per_sample)} mL CitraHB Complete + ${fmt(detergent_uL, 0)} µL Detergent`},
  {Action: "Count an aliquot on a hemocytometer (method below).", "Per sample": "—"},
  {Action: "Spin 10 min at 500×g, 4°C; discard the supernatant.", "Per sample": "—"},
  {Action: "Resuspend the pellet in resuspension buffer; pipette gently, do not vortex.", "Per sample": `${fmt(wash_per_spin)} mL`},
  {Action: `Spin 10 min at 500×g, 4°C; discard the supernatant.${n_wash_spins > 1 ? ` Repeat the resuspend + spin so the nuclei are washed ${n_wash_spins}× in total.` : ""}`, "Per sample": n_wash_spins > 1 ? `${fmt(wash_per_spin)} mL per wash` : "—"},
  {Action: "Resuspend the final pellet; count on a hemocytometer.", "Per sample": `${fmt(final_resus_uL)} µL`},
  {Action: "Load for single cell.", "Per sample": "—"}
].map((r, i) => ({Step: i + 1, Action: r.Action, "Per sample": r["Per sample"]}))

Inputs.table(homog_rows, {layout: "auto"})
```

::: {.callout-tip}
## Hemocytometer counting method
Nuclei yields are typically too low for a reliable Countess (automated) read, so this is a **manual hemocytometer count** every time.

a. Filter your trypan blue stock through a 0.2 µm filter before use; unfiltered trypan blue carries particulates that get miscounted as nuclei, and this matters more at low nuclei numbers where a few false counts skew the result.
b. Mix the nuclei suspension with filtered trypan blue at a **1:1** ratio (e.g. 10 µL suspension + 10 µL trypan blue, dilution factor = 2).
c. Load 10 µL of the mix onto the hemocytometer; let it wick in by capillary action, no bubbles.
d. Under the microscope, count nuclei in the 4 corner grid squares (16 small squares each). Count nuclei touching the top and left borders of a square, but not the bottom or right, to avoid double-counting nuclei that sit on a line.
e. Calculate concentration:

$$Nuclei/mL = \frac{\text{sum of nuclei in 4 corner squares}}{4} \times 2\ (\text{dilution factor}) \times 10^4$$

Divide by 1000 to convert to nuclei/µL for loading calculations.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
## Checklist
- [ ] Trypan blue filtered (0.2 µm) before use
- [ ] Nuclei intact and free of debris under the hemocytometer
- [ ] Post-homogenization nuclei concentration: _______ nuclei/µL
- [ ] Final nuclei concentration: _______ nuclei/µL
- [ ] Loaded for single-cell run at: _______
:::
